profile.reasoning: Viktor Almeida is a Brazilian-South African founder currently scaling a fintech platform focused on providing micro-loans to smallholder farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa. He built the initial tech stack while working as a software engineer at a major bank in Johannesburg, identifying a massive underserved market. He’s now raised a seed round and is focused on expanding into new markets within the region and securing Series A funding. He’s particularly interested in connecting with investors and advisors who have experience in African fintech, impact investing, and scaling tech businesses. He’s very comfortable with remote work but occasionally travels to key markets. A distinctive detail is his fluency in Portuguese, English, and Afrikaans – crucial for navigating the diverse linguistic landscape of his target markets.
profile.positioning: Viktor Almeida is the Founder & CEO of AgriLend, a fintech platform democratizing access to finance for smallholder farmers in Africa. We leverage mobile technology and alternative credit scoring to provide micro-loans, enabling farmers to increase yields and improve their livelihoods. Having recently closed a seed funding round, AgriLend is focused on aggressive expansion across Sub-Saharan Africa, with initial focus on Zambia and Mozambique. I am passionate about bridging the financial inclusion gap and building a sustainable, impactful business that empowers communities. I’m actively seeking connections with investors, advisors, and potential partners who share this vision.
